test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow (s) from the statements.

**Statements**:

Some chairs are windows.

all windows are boards.

**Conclusions**:

I. All chairs are boards.

II. All boards are windows.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2385a164cfebad1a368f84c719d8f7ec17e93c1317a5c7c48aaa226d8ffb3c22.png] 

I) All chairs are boards → Does not follow → As all windows are board and some chairs are windows. So all chairs are boards it can be possible but not definite.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9598cf8fcf01c542bce02c991079023bbeade7c5b666d11cab4552e90806874e.png] 

II) All boards are windows → Does not follow → As all windows are boards, So all boards cannot be windows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Neither conclusion I nor II follows".
